column76: A conventional oilfield is a candidate for near-term CO2 EOR if its present day oil saturation (So) is between 25% and the sum of 30% plus 15% of original oil in place (OOIP).  Above this range, and the oilfield is likely to remain in primary or secondary (waterflood) production; below this range, and it is unlikely there is enough oil remaining for economic CO2 EOR.
